title: Pickled German Vegetable Salad
description: A refreshing Mexican-inspired salad featuring pickled vegetables and a tangy dressing.

ingredients.name: German vegetables (such as cabbage, carrots, and beets)
Lightly pickled vegetables (such as cucumbers and red onions)

instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced German vegetables and pickled vegetables.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sour cream and lime juice until smooth.
Pour the sour cream dressing over the vegetables and toss to combine.
Add the mixed greens and chopped cilantro to the bowl and toss again to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
